owner_note.text: Every one of the 167 candidates is either loaded in a way the census can't see (76) or a note worth keeping (91); a spot-check overturned all 4 "dead" calls. Nothing to retire, so nothing was moved. The mover is ready anyway: `node Server/retire-files.mjs --plan`, `--apply` when you agree, `--undo` to put files back. The census's bare-name rule is the cause of the false alarms.
